name: 3S Map
author: Joakim
description: Automapper: learns rooms as you walk, draws a live HUD map with exit connections between rooms on a woven grid, walks you to any mapped room, detects reckoning drift, stitches per-area maps together at their boundaries (compass or portal, with automatic return links for compass crossings), seeds areas from maps.json, and emits map.room / map.walk.* events other plugins can listen to.
